description: Connects a domain and its www name to a website built and hosted on InstaBuild, and adds an ownership TXT record. For Cloudflare DNS only: Cloudflare flattens a CNAME at the root and does not support APEXCNAME. InstaBuild requests this service only when discovery returns Cloudflare, without host. hostRequired is set only because a CNAME at @ requires it (DCTL1012). Mail and other records are not touched.
variableDescription: %verify%: the 32 character hex ownership code InstaBuild shows the owner for this domain
